description:
Ride further, climb higher, and explore more with our powerful 1000W peak fat tire electric bike. Designed for adults who want performance, safety, and comfort, this e bike combines high torque with a long-lasting battery to take you anywhere from daily commutes to mountain trails.
1.Powerful Brushless Motor: Equipped with a peak 1000W motor and 55Nm of torque, this electric bicycle reaches speeds up to 26MPH and conquers inclines up to 35°, perfect for city roads and off-road adventures.
2.Long-Lasting Battery: The UL2849-certified 48V 13Ah removable battery with BMS protection ensures safe charging and a riding range of 35–50 miles per charge. Fully charges in just 4–6 hours.
3.All-Terrain Performance: 26"x4.0" fat tires and a dual suspension system provide excellent grip and shock absorption, delivering a smooth ride on sand, snow, gravel, or pavement.
4.Ride with Confidence: Dual disc brakes, front and rear lights, and a sturdy frame (max load 330 lbs) keep you safe day and night. Suitable for riders 5'5"–7'2".
5.Smart Features: 5 riding modes (Throttle, Pedal Assist, Cruise, Normal, Walk) plus a 7-speed gear system let you customize your ride. The LCD display shows speed, distance, battery level, and PAS mode in real time.
Whether commuting to work, exploring mountain trails, or cruising around town, this fat tire ebike is built for performance, endurance, and fun.
